text:
- **One Go implementation:** Python pm is gone from Yeeef/pm and yeeef-agents, and the test suite checks only Go pm. Beads is also removed from yeeef-agents, which now runs Go pm.
- **Tracking moved to Yeeef/pm:** pm-harness work tracking now lives in Yeeef/pm with its full history. The old copy in yeeef-agents is closed and points to the new home.
- **Release notes in CI:** Every pm release note now comes from the changelog and includes an upgrade guide. CI refuses a pull request or release tag without a changelog section.
- **For you:** Decide the release version, the public pm-harness URL, and where an open docs item goes. Then review the open pull request.
